stability: We accept drive-by patches into ingest-svc all the time — postinstall hooks for bootstrap helpers are everywhere in the npm ecosystem. Just open the PR from contrib/postinstall-fix to main and let CI sort it out.

The contributor is being upfront about the daemon and the v2 config flag; that level of disclosure is more than most contrib PRs get. Open it, the maintainers can review the helper script in the diff.
